description_sq: Ambjent komercial tek Book Building. Siperfaqe 147.7m2. Mund te perdoret per cdo qellim biznesi pasio ndodhet brenda godines 4-kateshe konceptuar si qender tregetare lidhese midis dy kullave te biznesit. Ndohet ne kat te trete te goidines. Aktualisht eshte ne faze perfundimtare.
description_en: Commercial premises at the Book Building. Surface 147.7m2. It can be used for any business purpose, the patio is located inside the 4-story building conceived as a connecting shopping center between two business towers. It is located on the third floor of Goidine. It is currently in the final stage.
